# HOI4 Portrait Workflows 3.1.0

This package contains four fully visible ComfyUI workflows for the distilled
FLUX.2 Klein 9B model and the tuned step-2500 HOI4 portrait LoRA.

## Included

- source-reference workflow with three candidates;
- text-to-image workflow with the exact example prompt;
- RealESRGAN + complete current Adonis Base → Post processing workflow;
- both official Adonis prompt branches, shared Base/Post seed, nine-step
  control, empty latent, Shark options, reference conditioning, and Base preview;
- sequential folder-batch workflow with one sampler;
- standard ComfyUI `KSampler` nodes with Euler, simple scheduling, four steps,
  CFG 1, guidance 1, full denoise, and visible seed controls;
- one narrow dark-brown setup card with a clear folder hierarchy and 16
  clickable model downloads;
- no redundant source preview—the upload node already shows the selected file;
- compact portrait-ratio comparison cards with 40 px gutters;
- red true/false controls and consistent node colours inside every group;
- expanded model, source-processing, and Adonis Base → Post nodes inside
  visible canvas groups with no hidden subgraphs;
- centered 1024×1365 and 156×210 PNG output;
- vanilla-style 156×210 A8R8G8B8 DDS output with no mipmaps;
- VRAM-guided full, FP8, and GGUF installation paths;
- all four LoRAs retained in every install: HOI4 step 2500, Adonis Base,
  Adonis Refine, and Adonis Post;
- pinned custom-node and model revisions.

## Storage

The shared support set is 12.893 GB. Exact complete model payloads are:

- full: 31.051 GB;
- FP8: 22.326 GB;
- GGUF Q4_K_M: 18.803 GB;
- GGUF Q5_K_M: 19.912 GB;
- GGUF Q6_K: 20.759 GB;
- GGUF Q8_0: 22.872 GB.

The Windows x64 executable installs into an existing ComfyUI. The RunPod
archive defaults to full distilled and accepts explicit `--variant` and
`--gguf-quants` selections.
